title: Ukraine war latest: Russia 'can't get a veto on peacekeepers' - as UK warns Putin will break deal without security guarantees
description: The UK has warned that Vladimir Putin will break any ceasefire deal that is not backed up by hard security guarantees. David Lammy, the foreign secretary, has also said that Russia should not have any say over whether Western troops are deployed to Ukraine as peacekeepers.
